results.title: Velos BioImaging — Label-free quantitative phase imaging for live-cell research
results.description: Velos BioImaging builds Velos QPI, a compact 630 nm ptychographic imaging system, and SPARK, its physics-based, sparse-scanning and AI-assisted reconstruction software, for label-free live-cell monitoring, cell biology and drug discovery.

results.title: Product — Velos QPI and SPARK · Velos BioImaging
results.description: Velos QPI compact 630 nm quantitative phase imaging hardware and the SPARK reconstruction platform: physics-based, sparse-scanning, AI-assisted and hybrid modes.
